name: RichDropdown
label: Rich dropdown
description: Dropdown's rich sibling: options preview their own heading face, body face, and key colour.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected option value for controlled use. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected option value for uncontrolled use.

props.name: options
props.description: The options on offer, in display order.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the newly selected option's value.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the selected option's `value` submits with an
enclosing form through a hidden input (nothing while no value is set,
nothing while disabled), as Combobox does. Also the fallback for the
element id (`id || name || label`).
